content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers

Traditional payment platforms like PayPal and Stripe provide an easy and familiar interface for transaction management, but they are not viable for many creators in West Africa due to regulatory restrictions and high transaction fees. In contrast, NOWPayments offers a solution that accommodates over 300 cryptocurrencies, allowing creators to accept payments without the need for bank accounts or KYC compliance. With COREMERCH's Complete Builder Kit, creators gain access to the tools needed to build a fully operational online store that integrates seamlessly with NOWPayments, empowering them to sell digital products globally while maintaining full ownership of their data and assets.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Handling restrictions in countries like Nigeria and Ghana is where blockchain-based payment solutions shine. Platforms such as Binance P2P facilitate direct transactions in local currencies like the naira and cedis, enabling creators to easily convert their earnings into usable funds. Meanwhile, NOWPayments processes payments in under 60 seconds for a fee of less than $0.10, making it a cost-effective option for creators in regions with limited access to traditional banking. This approach not only circumvents the limitations imposed by conventional payment systems but also offers a secure and efficient method for receiving payments from international buyers.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

When it comes to payment speed and fees, blockchain-based payments outperform traditional platforms significantly. For instance, transactions using USDT on the Tron network settle in under 60 seconds with minimal fees. In contrast, platforms like PayPal can impose high transaction fees and lengthy processing times, especially for international transfers. By utilizing NOWPayments, creators are charged only a 0.5% fee on transactions, making it a financially sound choice. This efficiency allows creators to focus on their products rather than worrying about payment delays or exorbitant costs eating into their profits.
Own your infrastructure, don’t rent it.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Ownership and control over your digital products is crucial for creators. Unlike conventional platforms that retain ownership rights and control over the sales process, COREMERCH solutions provide creators with full ownership after deployment. This means creators can sell their products without being subjected to platform regulations or fees. Automation is also a significant advantage, as NOWPayments offers automated payment verification and product delivery, streamlining the purchasing process for customers while ensuring that creators receive their payments immediately. This infrastructure sovereignty empowers creators to operate independently and build sustainable businesses.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

The choice of architecture depends on the specific needs of the creator. For those who require a quick setup with limited products, the Sovereign Starter Stack is ideal. However, for creators looking for a more robust solution with enhanced features, the Edge Commerce Stack provides greater flexibility and scalability. The Complete Builder Kit is an all-encompassing resource that includes everything needed to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack. With instant access to all six blueprints and seven templates, creators can customize their platforms to fit their unique requirements and maximize their revenue potential.
How can creators in Africa sell digital products to international buyers?

Global access through sovereign infrastructure works because every layer of the stack is geography-neutral by design. Cloudflare Pages serves your storefront from data centers close to your buyer — whether they are in London or Lagos, the page loads in under 200 milliseconds. NOWPayments generates a unique payment address for each transaction — the buyer sends crypto from any wallet, anywhere in the world. The blockchain confirms the transaction regardless of which country the sender is in. Your Cloudflare Worker receives the webhook and processes the order using the same logic for every buyer.
